description: Turn a described need into a link the person opens themselves: a consultation with Cbest's adviser, prefilled with the need. The adviser knows the whole catalog, answers with real products and builds a list of materials; Cbest then checks price and stock and issues the quote itself. Nobody is handed to another company, there are no contact details in this server, and this call does not contact anyone. It stores nothing and it REFUSES any personal data — no name, no number, no email. Describe the project, not the person.

client.description: Optional: a short name for your app, so we can tell which assistants send people here. Self-reported, lowercase slug.

need.description: The project in the person's own terms, in Persian or English — space, use, style, constraints. No personal details: the call is refused if it contains a phone number, an email or a handle.

name: start_consultation
